chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever recognizes the merit of an elder due to his age and dignifies him, Allah will secure him from the horror of the Day of Judgment.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for respecting elders in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni links this prophetic tradition to the broader concept of *adab* (etiquette), framing respect for elders as a tangible means of securing divine protection from the *Faz'* (great fright) on the Day of Resurrection. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on social hierarchy and the spiritual merit of honoring those with seniority, viewing it as a practical application of piety that mitigates eschatological anxiety.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who recognises the merit of old age, so he dignifies him, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Secure him from the horrors of the Day of Judgment’’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Whoever recognizes the excellence of an old person due to his age and treats him with dignity, Allah will grant him protection against the horror on the Day of Judgment.’”
